text: Iran's six-member team won four gold medals to top the Fourth International Mathematics Competition in Beijing, beating 49 countries and finishing ahead of Poland and Brazil. The squad now advances to the International Mathematical Olympiad in Shanghai.

President Trump said 1,000 missiles are ready for use against Iran, after intelligence shared by Israel described internal Iranian discussion of killing him, though officials say no specific plot was identified.

Judges in France upheld Marine Le Pen's conviction for embezzling 2.8 million euros in European Parliament funds, a ruling her supporters call political persecution. Le Pen faces a separate appeal ahead of France's presidential vote next April and May.

India's space agency ISRO is developing a reusable rocket recovery method using an unpowered glider that lands on a runway, differing from the powered vertical landings used by SpaceX and China. ISRO has not set a timeline for attempting recovery of an orbital-class booster.

The Pentagon added Tencent, Alibaba, DJI and Unitree to its list of Chinese Military Companies, a designation meant to steer US government contracts and investment away from the named firms. None of the four companies has said whether it will contest the designation.

India and New Zealand concluded a free-trade agreement, with New Zealand pledging 20 billion New Zealand dollars in Indian investment as both countries target 7 billion New Zealand dollars in bilateral trade by 2030.

Astronomer David Kipping says every past claim of detecting alien life has collapsed under scrutiny and argues the search should shift from pattern-matching odd signals to rigorous, probability-based tests of competing hypotheses — including the possibility that humanity…
Analysts say bitcoin's four-year cycle, tied to its mining-reward halving next due April 2028, is flattening as growing ETF and institutional ownership dampens volatility.

Samsung's Galaxy XR mixed-reality headset launched in the UK on Tuesday priced at £1,699, following earlier debuts in South Korea and the US. Buyers pairing the device with a Galaxy phone receive a 10% discount through August 4.
